Pinned third-party releases, copied unchanged, never loaded from a CDN.

| Folder | What | How it was made |
|---|---|---|
| `drishti-elements/3.2.0-dev+2b87fcd/` | Drishti Elements 3.2.0-dev at commit 2b87fcd (origin/g2/integration, with g3/kinds: the live kind, cell bars, series marks, treemap, bullet; adds SplitPane, Tabs, NavList, ColumnMap, the painter's `complete` option, and the painter's side of state and effects, contract 1.2: `handle.fire`, `handle.change`, `options.host`; the form panel, panel actions): `drishti-core`, `drishti-views` (the painter, `<elements-view>`), `drishti-events`, `drishti-grid`, `drishti-graph` (network-graph) and `drishti-tree` (tree-table) as the library fragments need them, `drishti-chart` (chart panels: line, area, waterfall, histogram, scatter, candlestick, surface, map, the hbar donut) with `drishti-inputs` (which it needs) and its engine (Apache ECharts 6.1.0, bundled into the script); one script and one stylesheet; `vendor/` holds the files the libraries read at run time (CodeMirror for inputs' code field, ECharts GL for 3D traces, loaded only when drawn), each with its licence; `data/` holds the shared tables Core formats with and reads regions from (`formats.yaml`, with the level-1.2 names `pct4`, `bp1`, `df4`, `price4`; `world-regions.yaml`; `drishti.elements.version` in java/pom.xml names this folder); `drishti-elements-pack.json` lists every file with its SHA-384 | `python3 tools/elements/cli.py pack --libs core,views,events,chart,grid,graph,tree --data` on commit `2b87fcd` of drishti-elements (engines included, no `--maps`: a map panel's shapes are the host's to serve) |
| `apache-arrow/21.1.0/` | **Apache Arrow JS 21.1.0** (Apache-2.0; `LICENSE`, `NOTICE` beside it): `Arrow.es2015.min.js`, the npm package's ES2015 UMD build (`window.Arrow` in a page; `require` in Node), 178,919 bytes, sha384 `fec07eec1aa5968e355e9ae768e5146afdc3d12d272293650c764fce1ae0c864183b3ecb7dba9d320a91b202f048fadb`. The data client reads Arrow IPC answers with it (`arrowPage`); loaded only by a page that asks for `form="arrow"` | the same file Drishti Elements vendors (`vendor/apache-arrow/21.1.0`, from `npm i --ignore-scripts apache-arrow@21.1.0`, its last line `//# sourceMappingURL=...` removed); `grep -E 'https?://'` finds only the licence URL in its header |
| `js-yaml/4.1.0/` | **js-yaml 4.1.0** (MIT, `LICENSE` beside it): `js-yaml.min.js`, the npm package's browser build (`window.jsyaml`), sha384 `fa9c6237a4fbcafa6bcae26613580cf4f5fbc908add796ae0dbf99c30bc939dff86ded8289ee7f22e5578106ff4bd76e`. Rachana Studio reads library fragment files (their typed parameters) with it; it never reads or writes Sutra text (the compiler bundle does) | the tarball of npm `js-yaml@4.1.0` (sha512 checked against the registry's integrity), `dist/js-yaml.min.js` copied unchanged |
